scope: Local synthetic engineering validation; not a production or pilot exit
navigation: Full document navigation from about:blank, authenticated synthetic owner
end: Expected business data, enabled primary control, successful required API responses, then two animation frames
warm_cache: Same context; two excluded warmups per route, then 30 recorded navigations
cold_cache: New context with restored test login per navigation; 30 recorded navigations
p95: Nearest rank: sorted ceil(0.95 * 30), i.e. 29th observation
failures: Retained as failures with 10000 ms measurement cap; never replace failed samples
viewport_check: Record primary business/control intersection with viewport without scrolling
build: Next.js 16.3 standalone production build with Webpack
outbound: Disabled; no LLM calls or background reminder scan
